# Epic: Brand Customization

## Overview
Create a comprehensive branding system that allows businesses to customize the look and feel of both staff-facing and customer-facing interfaces.

## Objectives
- Enable business logo and color scheme management
- Create email template customization
- Implement custom domain setup
- Configure PDF template styling
- Create mobile app white-labeling
- Set up customer portal branding

## Features
1. [Brand Assets](./branding/01-brand-assets.md)
2. [Email Templates](./branding/02-email-templates.md)
3. [Portal Customization](./branding/03-portal-customization.md)
4. [Document Templates](./branding/04-document-templates.md)
5. [Mobile Branding](./branding/05-mobile-branding.md)

## Technical Requirements
- Implement asset management system
- Create template engine
- Enable custom CSS injection
- Implement custom domain handling
- Create PDF generation system
- Enable mobile app theme configuration

## Acceptance Criteria
- Businesses can upload and manage brand assets
- Email templates render correctly
- Customer portal reflects brand identity
- PDF documents maintain consistent branding
- Mobile app shows correct branding
- Custom domains work properly

## Dependencies
- Core API Epic
- Integration Management Epic

## Estimate
- Story Points: 21
- Timeline: 2 weeks

## Technical Notes
- Use CDN for asset delivery
- Implement template caching
- Use CSS isolation for portals
- Consider using Liquid for templates
- Implement asset optimization
- Use secure custom domain setup
